card.title: Belonging on Changing Terms
card.instruction: Seek acceptance by adapting quickly, then let each adaptation create a new version of yourself you must defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You wanted a more adventurous friend, so I've booked us climbing lessons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant trying a new cafe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Well, I'm a climbing person now. I've told my sister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cancel. I need a friend who listens.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'm a listener. Will you tell my sister I listened to you, rather than gave up climbing?
